lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twelve? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 12? Nope!

lines.text: A B and A C are ten. B C is twelve.
lines.caption: AB and AC are 10. BC is 12.

lines.text: The top line is parallel to B C. Angle B's bisector meets it at F. Find A F!
lines.caption: The top line is parallel to BC. Angle B's bisector meets it at F. Find AF!

lines.text: The bisector cuts angle B in half. Call each half x.
lines.caption: The bisector cuts angle B in half. Call each half x.

lines.text: Find the Z! Across the parallel lines, the angle at F is x too.
lines.caption: Find the Z! Across the parallel lines, the angle at F is x too.

lines.text: So triangle A B F has two equal angles. A F equals A B!
lines.caption: So triangle ABF has two equal angles. AF equals AB!

lines.text: A B is ten, so A F is ten!
lines.caption: AB is 10, so AF is 10!

lines.text: Twelve was the trap. Parallel, but not equal!
lines.caption: 12 was the trap. Parallel, but not equal!

lines.text: Did you get ten? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 10? Tell me below!
